instagram.caption:
The man who invented Tetris earned nothing from it for 12 years.

Alexey Pajitnov made it in 1984 on a computer at a Soviet research center in Moscow, so the state owned the rights.

Tetris sold millions of copies around the world, most famously with the Game Boy, while he got no royalties. He finally started getting paid in 1996.
